P.No. 1 of 15 ss Charu Gupta Gupta Date: 2025.03.11 04:11:33 +0530 3. Cholamandalam Ms General Company Limited office at: Plot No.6, Pillar no.81, Pusa Road, New Delhi, Insurance Company/Respondent no.3 Date of accident : 29.09.2022 Result of accident : Grievous injury Date of filing of Dar : 06.01.2023 Date of Decision : 11.03.2025 Award 1. The present DAR (detailed accident report) arises out of an accident that occurred on 29.09.2022, resulting in grievous injury to the victim/claimant Kamlesh Kumar Mishra.
texts.facts: When the informant tried to turn of its DVR, the driver of the offending vehicle drove away his car at a high speed towards MB Road with sudden jerks and also hit against a Passion Pro motorcycle bearing no.DLSEK0789 on which two persons were riding. One of the rider of such motorcycle is the claimant in the present DAR, who suffered grievous injury. Claimant was rushed to the hospital where he received treatment. 3. On complaint of the Govind (also injured in the accident), an FIR no. 0393/2022 was registered u/s 279/338 of IPC against respondent no.1. 4. Respondent no.1 is the driver, respondent no.2 is the owner (since deceased) of the offending vehicle and respondent no.3 is the insurance company with which such offending vehicle was insured. 5. In the instant case, respondents not filed any written statement. Petitioner also sustained open grade 1 BB left leg fracture without DNVD. He was discharged on the same day. As such, Rs.40,423/- granted to towards loss of actual income. Total compensation after deduction Rs.3,08,674/- Interest: Simple interest @7.5% p.a. from the date of filing of DAR till actual realization of Award amount/ compensation. LIABILITY 16. As already discussed, principal award amount/ compensation will be payable by respondent /insurance company with simple interest @7.5% p.a. from the date of filing of DAR till actual realization. In case, the interest of petitioner was stopped or excluded during the present inquiry proceedings, same is liable to be adjusted from the total interest calculated on the Award amount. Similarly, amount awarded and released as interim Award, if any, during pendency of the case, be deducted from the total compensation amount. P.No. 9 of 15 ss Digitally signed by CHARU CHARU GUPTA GUPTA Date: 2025.03.11 04:12:11 +0530 with State Bank of India, Saket Court Branch, New Delhi by way of RTGS/NEFT/IMPS in account of MACT SAVING ACCOUNT No. 00000042706875094, IFS Code SBIN0014244 and MICR code 110002342 under intimation to the Nazir in the prescribed format i.e. MCOP Number on the file of (Claims Tribunal Name) Date of award, Compensation Amount, Income Tax Deduction at Source, Bank Transaction Reference No./Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) Number. In turn, the State Bank of India, Saket Courts Branch shall receive the deposited sum and capture the above information and furnish a statement of account on a daily basis to the Nazir of this Tribunal to reconcile the deposits of compensation and the respective MCOPs towards which such deposits are made. On such deposits being made, the respondents shall submit a letter to the Nazir of this Tribunal enclosing a copy of the said bank advice, in prescribed format as above, as per which the deposit made to the bank account of this Tribunal, to enable this Tribunal to keep tab on the deposits made and the MCOPs for which they were made.
